caption: The drawing depicts a toy train engine predominantly colored in red, with areas showing visible wear and scratches. The train has a cylindrical boiler with black bands, a rectangular cab with windows, and three smokestacks situated on top. The front of the train features a cowcatcher, angled downward with red and black accenting. The wheels consist of two large black ones toward the back and two smaller pairs in front, each with a metallic look. The train engine is illustrated against a plain off-white background, with no other objects or scenery present.
title: Toy Locomotive
